Types

AvarSegment = tuple[fromV, toV: float32]
Avar remapping segment. 
FontError = object of CatchableError
FvarAxis = object
  tag*: uint32               ## Axis tag.
  min*: float32              ## Minimum user value.
  default*: float32          ## Default user value.
  max*: float32              ## Maximum user value.
  hidden*: bool              ## True when the axis is hidden.
  nameID*: uint16            ## Name table id.
Variable font axis. 
LocaCache = ref object
  done*: bool                ## True once parsing was attempted.
  ok*: bool                  ## True when parsing succeeded.
  starts*: seq[int]          ## Glyph start offsets.
  ends*: seq[int]            ## Glyph end offsets.
Lazily parsed loca offsets. Created once per parsed font and shared through SfntFont copies (same pattern as the shaper's outline cache); the table bytes are immutable so no invalidation is needed. 
NameEntry = object
  platformID*: uint16        ## Platform id.
  encodingID*: uint16        ## Encoding id.
  languageID*: uint16        ## Language id.
  nameID*: uint16            ## Name id.
  bytes*: seq[uint8]         ## Raw name bytes.
Name table record. 
SfntFont = ref object
  bytes*: seq[uint8]         ## Raw font bytes shared by copies.
  tables*: seq[TableEntry]   ## Table directory entries.
  unitsPerEm*: uint16        ## Design units per em.
  numGlyphs*: uint16         ## Glyph count.
  numHMetrics*: uint16       ## Horizontal metric count.
  locaFormat*: int16         ## Short or long loca offsets.
  hasVMetrics*: bool         ## True when vertical metrics exist.
  numVMetrics*: uint16       ## Vertical metric count.
  isSymbol*: bool            ## True for symbol encoded fonts.
  cmapOffset*: int           ## Selected cmap subtable offset.
  cmap14Offset*: int         ## Format 14 subtable offset or -1.
  names*: seq[NameEntry]     ## Name records.
  fvarAxes*: seq[FvarAxis]   ## Variation axes.
  avarMaps*: seq[seq[AvarSegment]] ## Per-axis avar maps.
  hvarStore*: VarStore       ## Horizontal advance variation store.
  hvarAdvMap*: DeltaSetIndexMap ## Horizontal advance index map.
  vvarStore*: VarStore       ## Vertical advance variation store.
  vvarAdvMap*: DeltaSetIndexMap ## Vertical advance index map.
  gdefVarStore*: VarStore    ## GDEF item variation store.
  locaCache*: LocaCache      ## Lazily parsed loca offsets.
Parsed font handle. A ref so copies share the (large) table bytes instead of deep-copying megabytes per call (Nim seq = is a deep copy); the parsed data is immutable, so sharing is safe. The lazily filled locaCache rides along through copies. 
TableEntry = object
  tag*: uint32               ## Table tag.
  offset*: int               ## Byte offset of the table.
  length*: int               ## Byte length of the table.
Font table directory entry.

proc applyAvarMap(segments: seq[AvarSegment]; v: float32): float32 {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Piecewise-linear avar remap of a normalized coordinate. Empty maps are identity; inputs outside the map clamp to its endpoints. 
proc cachedGlyphOffsets(f: SfntFont): tuple[ok: bool, starts, ends: seq[int]] {.
    ...raises: [FontError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
glyphOffsets, parsed once per font. Outline/extent lookups call this per glyph, and a full loca walk per call costs milliseconds on large fonts (50k glyphs). Falls back to the uncached walk when the font bypassed parseFontData (no cache allocated). 
proc decodeNameBytes(e: NameEntry): string {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Decodes a name record to UTF-8; other platforms use Latin-1. 
proc drawGlyph(f: SfntFont; gid: uint32; cb: proc (op: DrawOp) {.closure.};
               coords: seq[float32] = @[]): bool {.
    ...raises: [FontError, Exception, KeyError], tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Emits the outline of gid as draw ops. TrueType glyf outlines take precedence when present, otherwise the CFF table is used. coords are normalized variation coordinates for gvar (CFF2 blending is a follow-up). Returns false when the glyph has no usable outline.

Converts 2.14 fixed point to float.

proc fontName(f: SfntFont; nameID: uint16; platformID = 3'u16;
              encodingID = 1'u16; languageID = 0x0409'u16): Option[string] {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Returns the decoded name table string for an exact (platform, encoding, language, nameID) match, falling back to any record with the same nameID. Unicode/Windows strings decode from UTF-16BE; other platforms use a Latin-1 pass-through.

Maps a (base, variation selector) pair through cmap format 14. Default UVS entries resolve to the nominal glyph; non-default entries resolve to their mapped glyph. Returns none when the font has no format 14 subtable or the sequence is not covered.
